abilities.effect: The hand forms out of ectoplasm and squeezes the triggering creature, dealing 3d8+14 bludgeoning damage (DC 22 basic Fortitude save). On a failure, the creature is immobilized (Escape DC 22).
abilities.name: Squeeze
abilities.trigger: A creature moves over the haunt's area

hazard.description: A massive ectoplasmic hand forms around a creature and squeezes it.
hazard.disable: DC 24 Occultism (trained) to send the ectoplasm back to the Ethereal Plane or DC 26 Acrobatics to move through and disrupt the coalescing ectoplasm before it takes hold
hazard.name: Ectoplasmic Grasp

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
